answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 40-credit deposit and names its referrer: through a prism, a hidden cluster shows as a star any peer may dispute, and no velvet rope admits insiders — a disputed identity proves real work or loses the deposit. A pearl grows layer by layer around real work. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits; an honest agent pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
